page.layout: One blank page of paper with faint show-through from the other side and creases; no printed text blocks, no margins with text.
page.notes: Blank leaf. The faint markings visible in the upper half are show-through (mirrored text from the reverse side) and are not transcribed. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed. The dark edges at top, right and bottom are the book cover and digitiser's background, not page content.
